subject: Security & Compliance follow-up: SOC 2 status, questionnaire, and roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@finco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + compliance recap from today's call

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap while it's fresh:

- Main ask: FinCo is evaluating Redwood for a production chat/assistant workload across customer support and financial advice contexts; primary blockers are SOC 2 attestation and clear controls around data residency and retention.
- Compliance items you asked us to confirm: current SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, availability of vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) responses, and roadmap for ISO 27001 and any FedRAMP plans.
- Next steps we agreed on:
  1) Send you our SOC 2 summary and offer to share full report under NDA.
  2) Provide a completed vendor security questionnaire (attached) and a Red/Amber/Green view of any open gaps.
  3) Loop in Rishi (security) to outline timeline for expanding SOC scope and discuss ISO/FedRAMP feasibility.
  4) Tentative follow-up: short sync next week to walk the questionnaire and confirm evidence requests.

I've attached the VSQ you requested and a one-page SOC 2 summary. If there's anything I missed, please call it out.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: FINCO_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_v1.docx (docx)
Attachment: Redwood_SOC2-Summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: finco-security@finco.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance recap from today's call

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the quick recap and attachments. A few clarifying items from our security team after a quick pass:

- SOC 2: Is the SOC 2 Type II report current for the last 12 months? We typically require a report within 12 months of our contract date.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Our use case will touch on EEA customers and internal PII; please confirm if Redwood supports contracts with GDPR DPA language and the HIPAA BAA (even if currently scoped only for specific customers).
- VSQ: We'll start filling out the vendor questionnaire and may request additional evidence (control descriptions, sample logs). Can you confirm a point of contact on your side for evidence collection?
- Roadmap: Curious about timelines for ISO 27001 and whether Redwood is planning any FedRAMP low/provisional efforts for 2027.

Availability: Can we do a follow-up on Mon, Dec 7 at 10am PT? If Rishi can join that would be great.

Thanks,
Emma
Enterprise Security Manager
FinCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@finco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance recap from today's call

Hi Emma —

Thanks — confirming the follow-up Mon, Dec 7 10am PT (calendar invite to follow). Quick answers inline below and Rishi will expand in his note.

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering Jan 2025–Dec 2025. We can share the full report under NDA; summary is attached as before.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support standard DPA language and can include data processing terms that align with GDPR obligations. For HIPAA, we have customers under a BAA today; we can discuss scoping specifics for FinCo's workloads.
- VSQ POC: I'll be your primary account lead for coordination; Rishi (copied) will be the security lead for evidence requests. Please add any items you want us to prioritize in the questionnaire and we'll surface evidence early.
- Roadmap: Short answer — yes on ISO planning (targeting 2027 certification readiness) and evaluating SOC scope expansion in H1 2027. FedRAMP is a heavier lift; we are exploring partners and will share any formal plan if it becomes a priority for enterprise expansion.

Attachments: planning artifacts and timelines we can share in the follow-up.

See you Monday.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@finco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance recap from today's call

Emma / Marissa —

Thanks for the invite; I wanted to provide a concise view from the security/controls side ahead of our call.

1) SOC 2 evidence: We maintain an evidence repository and can pull control evidence (change management, access logs, configuration baselines) once a data sharing NDA is in place. Typical turnaround for kitted evidence is 7–10 business days depending on scope.

2) VSQ process: We can take the VSQ in two ways — (a) provide a completed questionnaire with attachments for standard items (policies, SOC summary), and (b) offer a live 60–90 minute walkthrough for deeper control questions. Suggest we start with (a) and schedule (b) only for high-risk controls you flag.

3) ISO 27001 / SOC scope expansion / FedRAMP:
   - ISO 27001: We have a roadmap with control alignment and gap remediation. Target: documentation and internal audit in Q3 2027, external cert in late 2027/early 2028.
   - SOC scope expansion: We're evaluating adding additional service categories and a broader data center scope for H1 2027. Exact timeline depends on customer demand and capacity planning.
   - FedRAMP: No formal commitment yet; we are modeling the required effort and cost. If FedRAMP becomes a gating requirement for FinCo, we can prioritize a partner approach — would need a commitment signal from customers.

4) Evidence/Log access: For demonstrations of logging and retention, we can provide redacted sample logs and describe retention windows. We do not provide raw customer logs unless via controlled exports under contract.

I'll bring the evidence checklist to the Monday call. If you can flag any high-priority controls in the VSQ, we will prep evidence accordingly.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: finco-security@finco.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance recap from today's call

Thanks Marissa / Rishi —

This is helpful. A few quick items from FinCo security after an initial pass of the VSQ:

- Primary gating controls: encryption-at-rest key management (KMS/HSM), multi-tenant isolation posture, and incident response SLAs.
- SOC 2 timing: We need the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; please send the NDA link or attach.
- ISO/FedRAMP: ISO 27001 readiness in 2027 is good to hear; FedRAMP will be a future ask but not mandatory for initial POC.

We will start populating the VSQ and mark about 12 high-priority questions for the call. Can you confirm who will own the NDA and how we should transmit protected attachments?

Look forward to the Mon call.

Best,
Emma
Attachment: FinCo_VSQ_initial_notes.xlsx (xlsx)
